title: Fabric Selection
subtitle: Pure Cotton & Silk Foundations
description: We select high-quality cotton or silk fabric that is durable, breathable and ideal for hand-painting.

title: Washing & Scouring
subtitle: Purification in River Waters
description: The fabric is thoroughly washed to remove starch, oils and impurities, making it ready for traditional treatment.

title: Myrobalan & Milk Treatment
subtitle: Traditional Mordant Soak
description: The fabric is soaked in a mixture of myrobalan (haritaki) and often milk. This traditional treatment helps the fabric absorb dyes better and gives a smooth, durable base.

title: Drying & Preparation
subtitle: Sun-Cured for Artistry
description: The treated fabric is dried in the shade and prepared for hand-drawing. This ensures the fabric is ready to absorb natural colours evenly.

title: Hand Drawing (Outlining with Kalam)
subtitle: Freehand Outlining with Iron & Jaggery
description: Skilled artisans draw intricate designs freehand using a traditional Kalam (bamboo pen) with natural dye made from iron and jaggery. This forms the outline for the artwork.

title: Preparing Natural Colours
subtitle: Earth, Bark, Minerals & Indigo
description: Colours are prepared from natural sources like indigo, madder, pomegranate rind, turmeric and other plant materials. These eco-friendly dyes give Kalamkari its rich and timeless shades.

title: Filling in Colours (Painting)
subtitle: Hand-Painting with the Bamboo Kalam
description: The outlined designs are carefully filled with natural colours using a Kalam (bamboo pen) or brush. Artisans apply each colour by hand with great precision and patience.

title: Washing for Clarity
subtitle: Washing Off Excess Dye
description: The fabric is thoroughly washed in clean water, often in flowing water, to remove excess dye. This step reveals the clarity of the design and prepares the fabric.

title: Washing & Finishing
subtitle: Sun-Dried Heritage Finish
description: After dyeing, the fabric is thoroughly washed in clean water to remove excess dye and fixed properly. The cloth is then sun-dried and finished for a soft, vibrant and long-lasting look.

title: 10-Step Journey Poster
subtitle: Srikalahasti Kalamkari Heritage
description: From fabric selection to final quality check: A living heritage woven and hand-painted across generations.
